g.text: Capture A in three permanent thirds, then escort the artifact to CP1, CP2 and the final CP3.
Gold: payload / stairs Cyan: skill shortcuts Green: medical Gray: solid architecture
All primary high ground has ordinary access. Missed shortcuts land on lower playable routes.
A0/D0 start · Capture activates A1/D1 · CP1 activates A2/D2 · CP2 activates A3 · CP3 ends the round
